reset: clears environment variables and setting default
useradd: adds a new user to the system
userdel: removes a user from the system
users: get a list of all user accounts
ls: lists the directories and files in pwd
du: calculates the disk used by specified path
mv: moves scr to dest as specified
cp: copies scr to dest as specified
man: returns manuals of command specified else all commands
date: returns the current time and date
